name: Sarah Greene
bio: Sarah Greene (born 24 July 1984) is an Irish actress and singer. She is best known for portraying Lorraine Waldron onn Normal People, Bibi Garvey on Bad Sisters, Maxine Carlson on Ransom, and Hecate Poole in Penny Dreadful.

credits.title: The Way of the Wind
credits.overview: A dramatization of several episodes in the life of Christ.

credits.title: TRAD
credits.overview: From their home in the Donegal Gaeltacht, gifted fiddle player Shóna McAnally and her little brother Mickey take to the road with a troupe of wandering musicians, on a cross-country journey of adventure, romance, and musical exploration.

credits.title: Father Mother Sister Brother
credits.overview: Estranged siblings reunite after years apart, forced to confront unresolved tensions and reevaluate their strained relationships with their emotionally distant parents.

credits.title: In the Land of Saints and Sinners
credits.overview: In a remote Irish village, a damaged Finbar is forced to fight for redemption after a lifetime of sins, but what price is he willing to pay? In the land of saints and sinners, some sins can't be buried.

credits.title: Rosie
credits.overview: A mother strives to shield her young family from their new reality when their landlord sells the property and renders them homeless.

credits.title: Black '47
credits.overview: In 1847, when Ireland is in the grip of the Great Famine that has ravaged the country for two long years, Feeney, a hardened Irish Ranger who has been fighting for the British Army abroad, returns home to reunite with his estranged family, only to discover the cruelest reality, a black land where death reigns.

credits.overview: Join Jason on a chemically enhanced trip through the streets of Dublin as he stumbles from one misguided adventure to another. credits.title: The Bunker
credits.overview: John was born the day the bombs fell and England became a forgotten wasteland. 30 years later he is alone - everyone he knew and loved has died - but one tiny incident sets off a sequence of disasters, and now he must escape, or die.

credits.title: Burnt
credits.overview: Adam Jones is a Chef who destroyed his career with drugs and diva behavior. He cleans up and returns to London, determined to redeem himself by spearheading a top restaurant that can gain three Michelin stars.

credits.title: Noble
credits.overview: Christina Noble overcomes the harsh difficulties of her childhood in Ireland to discover her destiny on the streets of Saigon. A true story.

credits.title: The Guard
credits.overview: When a small-town Irish cop with a crass personality is partnered with a straight-laced FBI agent to bust an international drug-trafficking ring, they must settle their differences in order to take down a dangerous gang.

credits.title: Love & Savagery
credits.overview: In 1969, a visiting geologist from Newfoundland arouses scandal in a small Irish village when he romances a local girl who’s destined for the convent.

credits.title: Eden
credits.overview: A married couple's relationship begins to fall apart as their 10th wedding anniversary approaches.
